summary: Iteration 57 batch tested. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed — forgot/reset password endpoints (generic ok, token persisted in db.password_reset_tokens, invalid token 400, short password 400), admin refund endpoint (404 unknown, 400 non-stripe, 502 fake stripe id via SDK invalid_request_error, 401 unauth), /purchases/my exposes stripe purchase, admin login works. Frontend: forgot-link switches auth to forgot mode with email-only form + support note; reset mode with FAKE token shows 'This reset link is invalid or has expired' 400 error; admin login (admin@frasberg.com/LuchiiAdmin2026!) lands on /chat with 'Welcome back' toast; navbar desktop order matches spec (Sign In, AI Models, Realms, API, Website Builder, Game Builder, Games, FrasbergOS, Explore) with no top-level Models/Brand; Explore dropdown first group is 'Explore' containing Chat, Developer Console, Benchmark, Realm, Mythos, API; footer Chat link href=/luchii, footer Company shows 'LLM Provider' (not 'Verified LLM Provider'); hero headline now 'Intelligence that truly gets you.'; /website-builder no longer shows 'WATCH LUCHII BUILD' showreel; /luchii serves the Chat interface; theme toggle from homepage sets html.light, /dashboard renders with html.light + body bg rgb(247,248,251) (white). Admin refund button code confirmed present in Admin.jsx (data-testid=refund-btn-{id}) with proper 'Refund & claw back' label and confirm dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4726 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (payments, admin, chat, etc.) for maintainability.

auth.py _send_reset_email: currently emails fail with Resend domain-not-verified error (logs: 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address'). Backend still returns generic ok but real users won't actually get reset links until a verified sender domain is configured on Resend. This is deployment config, not a code bug.
Admin.jsx refund toast reads r.data.clawed_back.toLocaleString() — if backend response omits clawed_back (e.g., zero credits) it will throw. Consider `(r.data.clawed_back || 0).toLocaleString()`.

Kubernetes ingress rewrites backend 502 JSON responses to HTML 502 pages — clients (including LinqHistory/Admin) will see non-JSON on genuine stripe failures; consider mapping SDK failures to a non-502 status (e.g., 400 or 422) so frontend toast can show the detail.
